paite: Huan Levi inn a pan pasal khat apaikhia a, Levi tanu zi in anei hi.
heading: Mosi Pianna
english: A man of the house of Levi went and took a daughter of Levi as his wife.

paite: Huai numei in nau apai a, tapa anei a, naupang melhoih ahi chih atheih in kha thum sung aselta hi.
english: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.

paite: Asel zoh nawn louhtak in, phaiphek bawm abawlsak a, vahaibuan leh chim in azutbit a, asung ah nau akoih a; luipang ah loupa kawm ah akoih hi.
english: When she could no longer hide him, she took a papyrus basket for him, and coated it with tar and with pitch. She put the child in it, and laid it in the reeds by the river’s bank.

paite: Asanggamnu'n bang hong suak hiam chih thei ding in gamla kuam ah adingh hi.
english: His sister stood far off, to see what would be done to him.

paite: Pharaoh tanu lui ah kisil ding in ahong paisuk a; anungzui numeite toh lui gei ah avak uhi. Loupa lak a bawm amu a, asikha numei khat va la ding in asawl hi.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter came down to bathe at the river. Her maidens walked along by the riverside. She saw the basket among the reeds, and sent her servant to get it.

paite: Ahonleh, naupang amuta a, ngai in, naungek akapta hi. Alainat a, "Hiai Hebru tate lak a khat ahi," achi hi.
english: She opened it, and saw the child, and behold, the baby cried. She had compassion on him, and said, “This is one of the Hebrews’ children.”

paite: Asanggamnu'n Pharaoh tanu kiang ah, "Naungek hon donsak ding, Hebru numeite lak a naudonmi khat hon va sapsak leng na ut hia?" achi hi.
english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh’s daughter, “Should I go and call a nurse for you from the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?”

paite: Pharaoh tanu in akiang ah, "Va kuan in,” achi hi. Nungak akuanta a, naungek nu ava samta hi.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Go.” The young woman went and called the child’s mother.

paite: Pharaoh tanu in akiang ah, "Hiai naungek la inla, hon donsak in. Na loh ka hon pe na ding," achi hi. Huchi in huai numei in nau alata a, adonta hi.
english: Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed him.

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, Pharaoh tanu kiang ah ahon pi a, huchi in atapa ahong hita hi. "Tui a pan ka kaihkhiak ahih ziak in, chi in amin Mosi asa hi."
english: The child grew, and she brought him to Pharaoh’s daughter, and he became her son. She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water.”

paite: Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Mosi ahong khanlet in chipihte kiang ah ava hoh a, apuakgikte uh ava mu hi. Asanggamte lak a khat, Hebru mi khat Aigupta mi in avuak lai ava muta hi.
heading: Midian Ah Mosi Asuakta
english: In those days, when Moses had grown up, he went out to his brothers and saw their burdens. He saw an Egyptian striking a Hebrew, one of his brothers.

paite: Adak loplop a, kuamah a-om kei chih atheihtak in, Aigupta mi athat a, piaunel ah asel hi.
english: He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no one, he killed the Egyptian, and hid him in the sand.

paite: Huan ani nih ni a, ava hoh nawnleh, ngai in, Hebru mite lak a mi nih ana kisual ua; gilou hihpa kiang ah, "Bangziak a na lawm vua na hia?" achi hi.
english: He went out the second day, and behold, two men of the Hebrews were fighting with each other. He said to him who did the wrong, “Why do you strike your fellow?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka tung ua lal leh vaihawm dia nang kua'n hon bawl ahia? Aigupta mi na thah bang a, hon thah tum na hi maw?" achi hi. Huchi in Mosi in alau a, “Hiai thil kitheikhe petmah ahita ve,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Do you plan to kill me, as you killed the Egyptian?” Moses was afraid, and said, “Surely this thing is known.”

paite: Pharaoh in hiai azak in, thah ding in Mosi azongta hi. Himahleh Pharaoh mai a pan Mosi ataimang a, Midian gam ah ava teng a; tuileh kiang ah atu hi.
english: Now when Pharaoh heard this thing, he sought to kill Moses. But Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and lived in the land of Midian, and he sat down by a well.

paite: Midian siampu in tanu sagih anei a, amau ahong pai ua, tui ahong tawi ua, apa uh belamhonte piak ding in atuitheite adim uhi.
english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters. They came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

paite: Belamchingte ahong pai ua, ahawlmangsak uhi. Himahleh, Mosi adingtou a, amau apanpih a, abelamhonte uh tui apia hi.
english: The shepherds came and drove them away; but Moses stood up and helped them, and watered their flock.

paite: Apa uh Reuel kiang a ahong paitak un, "Bangziak a, tuni'n hong pai baih ve uchia?" ana chi hi.
english: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”

paite: Amau, "Belamchingte khut a pan Aigupta mi khat in hon hunkhia a, tui leng ahon tawisak a, belamhonte tui apia hi,” achi uhi.
english: They said, “An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds, and moreover he drew water for us, and watered the flock.”

paite: Ama'n atanute kiang ah, "Ahihleh amah koi a om ahia? Bangziak a huai mi hon nusia? An ne ding in va sam ve ua," achi hi.
english: He said to his daughters, “Where is he? Why is it that you have left the man? Call him, that he may eat bread.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi bel huai mi kiang a ten alungkim a, ama'n atanu Zipporah, Mosi apeta hi.
english: Moses was content to dwell with the man. He gave Moses Zipporah, his daughter.

paite: Ama'n tapa aneihsak a, "Melmak gam ah mikhual ka hita," achih ziak in amin Gershom asa hi.
english: She bore a son, and he named him Gershom, for he said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land.”

paite: Hun hong pai zel in hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta kumpipa asita a, huchi in akoltan ziak un Israel suante athumthum ua, akap ua, koltan ziak a akahna uh Pathian kiang atungtou hi.
english: In the course of those many days, the king of Egypt died, and the children of Israel sighed because of the bondage, and they cried, and their cry came up to God because of the bondage.

paite: Amauna uh Pathian in aza a, huchi in Pathian in Abraham toh, Isak toh leh Jakob toh athukhun atheigige hi.
english: God heard their groaning, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, with Isaac, and with Jacob.

paite: Pathian in Israel suante a-en a, Pathian in amau aphawk hi.
english: God saw the children of Israel, and God understood.
